variants.headline: A fair hearing is a principle too
variants.body: There is not enough food in {colony}. People are hungry, and the political debate must answer that simple, urgent fact. We stand with {target}.

variants.headline: Stand firm against easy blame
variants.body: Food is insufficient and people are hungry in {colony}. Political principles should be judged by what they mean for those people. We stand with {target}.

variants.headline: Hunger does not make every accusation just
variants.body: People are going hungry in {colony} because food is insufficient. Any political argument should keep their needs at its centre. We stand with {target}.
